Name: Motorcycle Sounds (Horse Overhaul)
Author: jerrylee22
Description:
Replaces sounds added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url] (petting, feeding, etc.) to better suit a mod with a motorcycle (which is a horse mount replacer). 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953]Motorcycle Mod[/url] and many tractor mods already include sounds for moving, so this is not included.

[url=https://youtu.be/NBzz6j0vnLw][size=6]Sounds Used[/size][/url] (Youtube Link)﻿

Mods Used in Media

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul
﻿[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953]Motorcycle Mod[/url]
I am waiting on akane2010/CyanFire before I can publicly post my recolor of the motorcycle and garage.﻿
